applies_why: The judge text addresses a collision over Matthew 1:20 in which the challenger's answer is the chain in [DR3] and the defender's answers are the chains in [CR2] and [CR3], so K-C governs.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: Phrase: weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse. Readings weighed: (1) it requires comparing the support of the two whole chains; (2) it permits resolving by noting competing readings of Matthew 1:20 alone.
why: The judge declares the clash underdetermined by noting the challenger's and defender's differing answers rather than weighing the two chains by footing, which K-C requires.
